mapper.insert: insert into ai_tool_call_log (conversation_id, user_id, tool_name, request_json, response_json, success_flag, error_message, create_time) values (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{toolName}, #{requestJson}, #{responseJson}, #{successFlag}, #{errorMessage}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from ai_tool_call_log order by id desc
